title: ClientList
description: Desktop client presence and remote close (capability client-remote-close). POST /v2/clients/presence body presenceRequest → presenceResponse (repeat = heartbeat; any principal, pending included); GET /v2/clients → clientList (owner with scope full: all; others: own user; pending: own token); POST /v2/clients/{instanceId}/close body closeRequest → 202 closeAccepted (403 client_close_forbidden {reason: pending|scope|otherUser}, 404 client_not_found, 409 remote_close_disabled); POST /v2/clients/{instanceId}/closing body closingRequest → closingResponse (the registering credential only; 403 client_close_forbidden {reason: notRegistrant}); host events cutex/client/closeRequested → closeRequestedEvent, cutex/client/stateChanged → stateChangedEvent.

deviceName.description: The requester's own desktop (its latest presence), else its token's name, else the host name (root credential).

local.description: The request arrived on a loopback listener.

installId.description: A new instance with this installId replaces earlier instances registered by the same credential only.

instanceId.description: New per app start; an id registered by another credential: 409 client_instance_conflict. A removed id cannot heartbeat while its removal receipt remains (409 client_instance_exited for the registrant); use a new instanceId. An existing instance cannot change installId.

heartbeatSeconds.description: Send presence again this often; online instances are dropped after 3 × heartbeatSeconds without one; closing instances after one heartbeatSeconds. Expiry is applied on the next registry operation (in memory only).

closeRequest.description: The open close request while state is closeRequested (for clients without the event stream, e.g. a pending device).

userId.description: User of the registering credential (owner for the root credential); null = pending device.

tokenId.description: Registering client / device token; null = the root credential.

current.description: Registered by the credential of this request.

state.description: closing: the instance already reported closing (no new event).

outcome.description: exited immediately removes the instance; registrant-only including retries. Removal receipts last at most 180 seconds, bounded to 1024; after eviction/expiry an unknown id returns 404.
